theme_description: Default theme for the standalone Class Creation Wizard. Self-contained (theme_base empty) so the tool renders identically with no engine present. Values mirror the wizard's historic hard-coded stylesheet for pixel parity. Format matches the O3DE editor theming system (AzQtComponents/Themes/<Name>/themeProperties.json) so the editor StyleManager / Theme Editor can read and author it. All wizard tokens live under the ClassWizard group; engine themes may add a matching ClassWizard block to override these down the line.
